aliasReview: No product-code, book-title or alternate identity aliases are approved. All 15 keys identify complete notices; none matches a system notice. The two Rival Guide notices share a literal title and year but differ in author lists and publisher punctuation, so their distinct immutable keys are retained without aliasing or joining. Technology Guide Update 1.0 is reviewed only under its literal versioned title; no alias to Technology Guide or another version is established.
discrepancies: Every retained notice is byte-identical to its source physical line and the committed upstream legal resource, and all immutable keys hash the exact raw line. No source wording was corrected. Rival Guide at lines 297 and 298 repeats the same title and copyright year with different author lists and publisher punctuation: line 297 names nine authors, while line 298 names only Brandon Hodge, Colin McComb, and Jason Nelson. Both notices are retained; the unresolved author discrepancy is independently held for each identity pending book-level evidence. Pathfinder Society Field Guide, Rival Guide, The Inner Sea World Guide and Undead Revisited retain their title-terminal periods. Taldor, The First Empire retains Authors: Mark Moreland, with Crystal Frasier, Violet Hargrave, and Isabelle Lee. Technology Guide Update 1.0 retains its versioned title and 2015 date. Pathfinder Chronicles Campaign Setting uses Copyright 2008 and lists Mike McArtor twice; both occurrences are preserved without an inferred correction. Literal copyright years, publisher names, contributor labels and punctuation are retained. No printed correction or complete book chain is established.
